param: hnsw_config.m / optimizers_config.memmap_threshold / quantization_config.scalar (accepted-PATCH persistence echo on describe + data-plane survival)

oracle.statement: PATCH hnsw_config {m:8} and optimizers_config {memmap_threshold:512} on a data-bearing collection are 200 and describe echoes m==8 / memmap_threshold==512 with points_count==5 and search returning 5; PATCH quantization_config {scalar:{type:int8}} on an empty collection is 200 and describe echoes scalar.type==int8 — non-200 with /healthz alive or 200-without-echo = Type4_StateLogicViolation; 5xx = Type3 only with /healthz liveness
